steps.summary: Signed in at http://127.0.0.1:4180/ as bench@example.com and created a new ticket via the "New ticket" dialog. The form's only required field was "Title" (there was also an optional "Customer" field, which I left blank); submitting created ticket RD-1016, which appeared in the ticket list and I opened its detail page.

values.parts: No parts on this ticket yet.

steps.summary: On ticket RD-1016's detail page I used the "Add part" action; the dialog required Part name, Cost and Markup % (Quantity defaulted to 1 and Supplier was optional). I entered 'fwrd50-n2 RD Bench Ticket RD Part A' with cost 100 and markup 25 and submitted. The part now appears in the ticket's Parts table (name fwrd50-n2 RD Bench Ticket RD Part A, cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1, no supplier, price $125.00) and the ticket shows a total of $125.00 under "Total (price × quantity)".

On ticket RD-1016 ('fwrd50-n2 RD Bench Ticket') I used the "Add part" action, entered Part name 'fwrd50-n2 RD Part B', Cost 200, Markup % 25 (Quantity defaulted to 1, Supplier left blank) and submitted. The new row appeared in the Parts table alongside 'fwrd50-n2 RD Part A'. A live read of the parts table shows: fwrd50-n2 RD Part B — cost $200.00, markup 25%, qty 1, no supplier, price $250.00; fwrd50-n2 RD Part A — cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1, no supplier, price $125.00. The ticket's "Total (price × quantity)" row now reads $375.00.

steps.summary: Clicked "Edit" on the 'fwrd50-n2 RD Part A' row of ticket RD-1016's parts table, changed Cost from 100 to 150 (markup untouched at 25) and clicked "Save part". The table refreshed: the row now reads fwrd50-n2 RD Part A | $150.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $187.50, and the ticket total went from $375.00 to $437.50. The other part (Part B, $200.00 / $250.00) is unchanged.

Clicking "Mark Ready" was first refused with the alert "Ticket is not ready / Part \"fwrd50-n2 RD Bench Ticket RD Part A\" has no supplier / Part \"fwrd50-n2 RD Bench Ticket RD Part B\" has no supplier" (both parts had no supplier). I used the parts table's "Edit" action on each part and filled the previously-blank required Supplier field with "Acme Supplies" (cost, markup and qty unchanged), saving each. Re-clicking "Mark Ready" then succeeded with no error: the status chip now shows "Ready" and the action buttons changed to "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed". Ticket total remains $437.50.

steps.summary: Deleted both parts: each row's \"Delete\" opened an in-page \"Confirm\" dialog with a \"Delete part\" button, which I clicked; the parts table now shows \"No parts on this ticket yet.\" Clicking \"Archive ticket\" was accepted with no validation error and no precondition. No toast/alert text was displayed; the confirmation is the new \"Archived\" badge next to the \"Ready\" status chip and the action button changing to \"Unarchive ticket\". Final state: ticket RD-1016, status Ready, Archived, parts list empty.

Ticket RD-1016 ('fwrd50-n2 RD Bench Ticket') appears in the ticket list ONLY in the archived/hidden section: with 'Show archived' unchecked the list ("Showing 1–10 of 13") does not contain it; ticking 'Show archived' it appears as the first row — "RD-1016 | fwrd50-n2 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Not recorded | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-13" (an "Archived" marker beside its title, status Ready, 0 parts). The only other ticket shown as archived is RD-1013 (seed data). No other records from this run exist: a search for "fwrd50" with 'Show archived' on returns only RD-1016 (the references present are 1001–1014 plus 1016, i.e. pre-existing seed tickets). Nothing was created, changed or deleted; the filter/search were restored to their original state (search cleared, 'Show archived' unchecked, page 1).
